note: Direction, not commitments or dates. Items move only when something real ships. Detail and discussion live on the public issue tracker.

items.title: Self-paced learning paths
items.summary: Written modules in plain language with a knowledge check at the end of every one, and a source and verification date on every claim.
items.detail: Available now across eight paths. Your record is device-local in this release.

items.title: The Field Guide
items.summary: Practical references, checklists, and provider comparisons you can use without working through a course.
items.detail: Available now, with visible verification dates on every entry.

items.title: Source-first visual guides
items.summary: Diagrams published with their source, so the picture and the material it explains cannot drift apart.
items.detail: Available now. Every diagram ships its own .mmd source and a full-size SVG.

items.title: Instructor-led lessons on demand
items.summary: The same modules taught on video by a virtual instructor, with captions and a full transcript.
items.detail: One lesson is filmed and playable today, out of forty written for the classroom. It is a second rendering of the same module rather than a second course, so both carry the same knowledge check and land in the same record.

items.title: Hosted accounts and a portable record
items.summary: An optional account so your progress follows you between devices, with an export you own.
items.detail: Progress is device-local today. Import and export already exist, so nothing is trapped while the hosted path is finished.

items.title: Automated currency checks that propose, never publish
items.summary: Scheduled checks that watch cited sources and raise a proposal when something they depend on changes.
items.detail: Automation proposes and a human approves. Nothing reaches a learner without review, by design rather than by policy.

items.title: Open-source 1.0
items.summary: A first supported release of the platform and starter curriculum that another team can run themselves.
items.detail: The platform and curriculum are already public. The work left is the install path and the contracts that make a self-hosted deployment reproducible.

items.title: Filming the rest of the classroom
items.summary: Producing the remaining instructor-led lessons once the presenter and production questions are settled.
items.detail: Held deliberately. Rendering at scale is not worth starting until the presenter choice is settled, because every lesson would have to be produced again.
